fit_reason: This is an engine-only listing (a standalone outboard motor on a stand with tank and hose), not a whole boat or vehicle, so it falls outside what we detail.
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Mariner 8 outboard. We detail whole boats and vehicles, so a standalone motor isn't something we take on, but if you ever sell a boat or car, we'd be glad to come to you and give you a quote on a pre-sale detail.
